name: Zone II · Scene 1: City at Peace — Torchlit Bridal Procession
zoneTitle: The Two Cities: Peace and Law (491–508)
greek: Ἐν δὲ δύω ποίησε πόλεις μερόπων ἀνθρώπων καλάς. ἐν τῇ μέν ῥα γάμοι τ᾽ ἔσαν εἰλαπίναι τε, νύμφας δ᾽ ἐκ θαλάμων δαΐδων ὕπο λαμπομενάων ἠγίνεον ἀνὰ ἄστυ, πολὺς δ᾽ ὑμέναιος ὀρώρει· κοῦροι δ᾽ ὀρχηστῆρες ἐδίνεον, ἐν δ᾽ ἄρα τοῖσιν αὐλοὶ φόρμιγγές τε βοὴν ἔχον· αἱ δὲ γυναῖκες ἱστάμεναι θαύμαζον ἐπὶ προθύροισιν ἑκάστη.
buckley: On it also he fashioned two beautiful cities of articulate-speaking men. In the one, indeed, were marriages and feasts; and they were conducting the brides from their chambers through the city with brilliant torches, and many a bridal song was raised. The young men were dancing in a circle, and among them flutes and lyres gave forth their sounds; and the women standing, each at her portals, admired.

worldModel.vision: White marble colonnades and golden-linteled portals illuminated by trans-orange torches (3959), festive white/gold/lilac chitons, and golden lyres.
worldModel.memory: Processional state transition: brides advance from domestic chambers (θάλαμοι) through public avenues as youths whirl in circular dance.
worldModel.controller: Civic kinship and celebration: acoustic synchronization of hymenaeus song, aulos flute, and phorminx lyre.

shots.name: From the Bridal Chambers
shots.beat: Under blazing torches they lead the brides from their chambers through the fair city as the hymenaeus rises.

shots.name: Whirling Dancers, Flutes & Lyres
shots.beat: Young men whirl in a circle while flutes and lyres sound in their midst.

shots.name: Women Admiring at the Portals
shots.beat: The women stand, each at her doorway, marveling as the torchlit cortège passes.
